Hon’ble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Mr. M.C. Pandey, Senior Advocate 
assisted by Mr. Devesh Upreti, Advocate 
for the appellants. 
Mr. Siddhartha Singh, Advocate 
for the respondent no.1. 
Heard on the delay condonation 
application seeking the condonation of 
07 days’ delay, which is not seriously 
being opposed by learned counsel for 
the respondent no.1. 
Delay is hereby condoned. 
Delay condonation application 
(CLMA No.6341 of 2016) stands 
disposed of. 
Admit. 
Summon the LCR. 
List in due course for final 
hearing. 
 (Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.) 
 29.07.2016 NISHANT
